newsitem.title: UK: Burton says director Stuart Rose resigns.
newsitem.headline: Burton says director Stuart Rose resigns.

text.p: British retailer Burton Group Plc said on Friday that Stuart Rose, chief executive of Burton Menswear, Dorothy Perkins, Evans and Principles, has resigned as a director.
The group said in a statement that Rose's resignation was effective from the close of business yesterday.

Burton earlier this week announced plans to demerge the group into create two separate retail groups -- Debenhams, its highly profitable department store business, and the struggling fashion multiples, which include Principles and Dorothy Perkins.
